we present the first batch FHE-OI that is secure against quantum attacks.
we provide a new third generation FHE based on AGCD without noise-free assumption and a batch version of the same.

third generation FHE can be applied in a wide range of settings and that FHE-OI can be as expressive as lattice-based FHE, even in the post-quantum regime.
FHE-OI is not limited to second generation techniques and can be efficiently ported to third generation.
